scope: T5.1 canon 30-34 automatic-renewal-by-minutes shared contract handoff

canonicalClaim.conditionalClause: The signed renewal includes an automatic renewal condition based on a known minutes threshold.
canonicalClaim.rule: Null values are deliberate. This workstream must not invent a threshold, evaluation window or extension duration that is not fixed by authoritative canon/shared contract design.

currentRuntime.offerShape: CareerOffer persists before and terms snapshots plus reason/date/id; MarketState.pending persists zero-or-one offer.
missingClauseAuthority: authoritative official-minutes evaluator for the clause

requiredSemantics: The clause is part of the formal offer/contract authority, not a narrative flag, tag or seed.
The exact clause survives offer creation, acceptance, save, restore and subsequent contract reads without reinterpretation.
Offer provenance identifies the exact signed terms including the clause; a generic 12-month renewal is not clause parity.
Counter/defer/reject cannot silently activate the clause as if the original offer had been accepted.

Clause evaluation uses authoritative official playing minutes for the defined evaluation window; aggregate form, roleScore, career appearances, reputation, age and narrative flags are not substitutes.
The automatic extension transition is idempotent: replay/retry/save-restore cannot apply the same earned extension twice.
Evaluation and read projections consume zero narrative RNG and do not mutate state until an explicit authoritative transition is applied.
Legacy saves without this future clause field remain migratable under the shared save-schema migration policy; absence must not be interpreted as an earned or failed clause.
The 30-34 event remains technical_adaptation until the exact persisted clause can be proven on the pending/signed offer.
prohibitedApproximations: contract.monthsRemaining as proof that the minutes clause exists
professional.roleSecurity or roleScore as official minutes
sport.careerAppearances as the clause evaluation total
SEED_ROLLING_CONTRACT or any other seed as the legal contract clause itself
offer reason text alone as proof of the clause
codexAcceptanceEvidence: Type/schema test showing the clause can be represented with an exact non-null canonical threshold once that value is authoritatively supplied.
Offer lifecycle test: create -> counter/defer/reject/accept with the clause and verify only acceptance installs the accepted clause state.
Save/restore test before and after acceptance preserving clause identity, threshold and provenance.
Official-minutes boundary tests immediately below, at and above the threshold using authoritative match/minutes data for the defined window.
Idempotence test proving the same threshold crossing cannot extend the contract twice.
Negative-proxy tests proving form, appearances, role and narrative flags cannot satisfy the clause.
Migration test for pre-clause saves preserving their historical contract semantics without fabricating a clause.
integrationOrder: Freeze/register the current 30-34 target before any event metadata/gate change that would create another content identity.
Shared contract owner defines and migrates the persisted clause schema plus authoritative minutes evaluation surface.
Canon/shared owner supplies the exact threshold/window/extension values; this 30-34 workstream does not guess them.
Only then may EVT_32_CON_001 require and certify the exact clause on its formal offer in a new coordinated content-identity batch.
